# Electricity Resolution

1) One Site Resolution

| Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co Limited | 7th Floor Sigma IT Park 703 (NM) | DigiTide | ParsvaTech |
| :---: | :---: | :---- | :---- |
| Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co Limited | 7th Floor Sigma IT Park 704(NM) | DigiTide | ParsvaTech |

   (Share Same Bill)

**PROBLEMS**

- Contract Demand: 186 kVA, set in 2023  
- Actual peak usage: 77.39 kVA, less than half of contracted capacity  
- Root cause: MSEDCL bills the higher of (65% of actual demand) or (40% of Contract Demand). At 186 kVA CD, that 40% floor works out to 74 kVA, so billing is done for 74 kVA every month no matter what you actually use  
- Proof: Billing history shows exactly 74 kVA billed demand for 12 straight months. Consumption swung from 16,415 units to a 65,401-unit in October(Sudden Spike). Demand charges never moved

**SOLUTION**

- Apply to MSEDCL to reduce Contract Demand from 186 kVA to 100 kVA \- [https://wss.mahadiscom.in/wss/wss\_Load\_Change\_request.aspx?utm\_source=chatgpt.com](https://wss.mahadiscom.in/wss/wss_Load_Change_request.aspx?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
- 100 kVA still gives 29% headroom over recorded peak  
- \*MERC Supply Code Regulations, 2014 require MSEDCL to action the reduction within two billing cycles of your request  
- Can Keep Maximum Demand around 110 or 120 to play it safe

**The numbers**

* Current demand charges: ₹29,600/month (₹3,55,200/year)  
* Post-reduction demand charges: ₹20,120/month (₹2,41,440/year) \- (new billed demand: 40% of 100 \= 40 kVA)  
* **Savings: ₹9,480/month, ₹1,13,760/year**  
* Rate confirmed directly off the bill: ₹400/kVA

Bill Reference \- [Mahavitaran - HT/LTIP E-Bill](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1jDbGeKst-dEd-_GkM4VT5T6PMrvNoDJs/view?usp=sharing)
